sourceDefinition.title: Vacuum multiplicity, distributions and predictivity
sourceDefinition.question: How do specified compactification models populate vacuum space, and what can their distributions or multiplicities establish?
sourceDefinition.summary: Distinguish multiple vacua at fixed flux, flux ensembles, accumulation near zero vacuum energy, probabilistic explanations and selection-based predictivity.

regimes: Source-defined scans, ensembles and analytic model classes
assumptions: Sampling and ensemble choices do not define a universal landscape measure
conventions: Fixed-flux multiplicity differs from varying-flux statistics
excludes: Promoting observed exclusions to universal theorems
Assuming a higher-dimensional positive cosmological constant has been derived from string theory

sourceDefinition.readingLimit: The excerpts support the fixed-flux multiplicity target; the distribution, typicality and predictivity topics are supplied as descriptions.

targetDefinition.title: Statistical rarity and uplift-induced mixing
targetDefinition.question: Under the stated random-Hessian approximations, how rare are tachyon-free Type IIA de Sitter extrema, and how does increasing vacuum energy affect stability through moduli mixing?
targetDefinition.summary: The source estimates search probabilities and discusses destabilizing off-diagonal terms. These are ensemble-dependent estimates and model observations, not a measured distribution over all string vacua.

targets: Destabilization during increases in vacuum energy
assumptions: A random matrix approximates otherwise complicated Hessian contributions
Mass hierarchies and relative off-diagonal sizes affect the estimate
Treating omitted modes as already stabilized has a limited energy range
conventions: Positive-definite Hessians are a stricter criterion than allowing flat directions
includes: Statistical and uplift-mixing parts of the source question

targetDefinition.readingLimit: Abstract and selected discussion pages only. The supplied v4 is stamped 17 Apr 2012; its title page is dated 18 Apr 2012.

originalProposal.reason: Reuse the same statistical-rarity question through the ensemble route; do not create a second route-dependent copy.
